answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cipher lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the raven is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
